page.layout: One column of running text, full width, with a few inline references in italic at the ends of paragraphs. No marginal notes. Roman numerals stand as bare numbers above each paragraph. Catchword at the lower right.

main_text.l: XXXVII.
Caussarum eorundem locupletissimum prom-
ptuarium Φυσιολογικὴ & Υγιεινὴ[?] subministrant.
XXXIIX.
Continenté vero caussam in Morbis nullam esse:
in Ægris haud diffiteor.
XXXIX.
Morbos contractos ab Aere vitioso, longè deteri-
ores esse censeo, quàm vel à cibo aut potu itidem
prauo.
XL.
Symptomatibus nullam deberi, nullamq; postu-
lare curationem; eademq; summè perterrefacere sæ-
pissimè Medicos, mirandum est. Galenus 12.Method.I.
XLI.
Dolor est sensatio tristis in sensu tactus, à qualita-
tib. ἀθρόως ἢ βιαίως[?] in sensoriū agentibus dependens.
XLII.
Menstrua purgatio ex omnibus hæmorrhagijs so-
la præternaturalis non existit. Galen.lib.3. de sympt.
XLIII.
Ast Semeioticæ eximia in universa arte necessi-
tas & præstantia existit. quod cum etiam animadver-
tisset Hippocrates, scimus quid in eadem operę & stu-
dij posuerit.
XLIV.
Solitus est dicere Galenus, perarduum esse Medi-
co, ægris absentibus tuto consulere; cum ipse Medi-
cus complura ex facie & tactu corporis, affectuum ar-
gumenta capiat, quàm vel ex urinis deprehendere pos-
sint. In Consilio pro puero Epileptico.

page.notes: Greek words are copied as far as legible: "Φυσιολογικὴ" and "Υγιεινὴ" and "ἀθρόως ἢ βιαίως" are uncertain in accents and some letters, so they are marked [?]. "Method.I." may be "Method.1.". The Roman numeral "XXXIIX." is printed as shown. The catchword "Vt" at the lower right is read as a catchword, not a signature. No page number or running head is printed.
